pairs.scratch_body_identity: must adjudicate raw creation/edit evidence if command uses a file

limitations: Only exact command bytes are counted; no whitespace normalization or semantic equivalence
Shell-based edits need raw-command adjudication; native edit brackets are conservative
Nonzero exit can be import/dependency failure, not issue reproduction
Successful helper checks, empty checks and unrelated tests are not consumer evidence
Source-only mechanical file guard does not certify intended implementation scope
Traces missing/ambiguous do not imply compliance; inspect raw outputs and issue input/expected output
